# Raft Design

> Raft Design is a bilingual AI-native studio working across the U.S. and
> Japan on brand, product, and digital experience. Founded by Lance Shields,
> a designer with twenty years of design leadership at Adobe and Walmart,
> and brand/product work with LegalOn, Visa, Hitachi, and Red Bull. The
> studio works hands-on, fast, and builds to move with change rather than
> around it.

## Studio
- [Home (English)](https://raftdesign.studio/): Studio thesis, practice areas, and origin story.
- [Home (Japanese)](https://raftdesign.studio/ja/): 日本語版ホームページ。
